verdict.rationale: Isaac Lab documents "standalone headless operation, from workstation to data center" that scales to clusters. Isaac Sim supports Docker containers for repeatable setups, standalone Python scripts, and pip/conda installs, and is positioned for integrating into testing and validation pipelines and automating workflows. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., CI runner/GPU-in-CI guidance), detailed headless-mode docs for Isaac Sim itself (headless is only stated for Isaac Lab), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.
